scientific_integrity: The theorem is an exact all-integer-parameter result; the included finite verifier is corroboration, not a substitute for proof. Priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Binary alternating hosts only; fixed integral exponent at least two; concatenated repeated roots rather than shuffle powers. Earlier optimization literature is not a counting theorem; inaccessible Kosowski 2004 full text and unindexed specializations remain originality risks.
title: A two-jump Fibonacci–Lucas law for scattered powers in alternating binary words
